About Fit Ninja

Built for Real Results. Powered by Science.

Fit Ninja is developed and backed by Social Ninja's AI Agency with a simple mission: to make world-class, scientific fitness coaching, progression algorithms, and custom nutrition accessible to everyone for less than a cup of coffee per day.

1,324+ Animated Exercises & Guided Player

Unlike generic fitness apps that provide static text or broken YouTube links, Fit Ninja includes 1,324+ high-definition animated video exercise demos for every barbell, dumbbell, cable, machine, and bodyweight movement. Our guided in-session workout player keeps your screen awake, tracks your sets, and automatically manages your rest intervals with audible cues.

AI Macro & Cultural Nutrition Engine

We believe diet should fit your lifestyle and culture. Fit Ninja dynamically computes your daily calories, protein, carbohydrates, and healthy fats tailored for High Protein Non-Veg, Indian Vegetarian (Paneer, Soya, Dal), Ketogenic, and Plant-Based Vegan dietary preferences.

100% Offline-Ready PWA

Fit Ninja operates offline with zero lag inside basement gyms or low-connectivity areas. Your workouts, routines, and macro logs are cached securely on your local device and sync whenever you're back online.
